parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the account name.

This parameter is required if you create a resource account.
This parameter is not required if you register an existing account
parameters.help_zh:
账号名称前缀。

如果是新建资源账号，则该参数必填。
如果是注册应用到已有账号，则该参数不需要填写
parameters.name: account_name_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The display name of the account.

This parameter is required if you create a resource account.
This parameter is not required if you register an existing account
parameters.help_zh:
账号显示名称。

如果是新建资源账号，则该参数必填。
如果是注册应用到已有账号，则该参数不需要填写
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the parent folder.

If you create a resource account and do not specify this parameter, the account is created in the Root folder by default.
This parameter is not required if you register an existing account
parameters.help_zh:
父资源夹ID。

如果是新建资源账号，该参数不填，则默认创建在Root资源夹下。
如果是注册应用到已有账号，则该参数不需要填写
parameters.name: folder_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the billing account.

If you create a resource account and do not specify this parameter, the account pays its own bills by default.
This parameter is not required if you register an existing account
parameters.help_zh:
结算账号ID。

如果是新建资源账号，该参数不填，则默认为自主结算。
如果是注册应用到已有账号，则该参数不需要填写
parameters.name: payer_account_uid

parameters.help_en:
The baseline item configurations.

If this parameter is specified, the baseline item configurations are merged with the specified account baseline. For identical baseline items, the configurations in this parameter take precedence. Leave this parameter empty, specify the account baseline by using the `BaselineId` parameter, and apply configurations to the account by using the existing baseline
parameters.help_zh:
基线项配置数组。

如果传递了该参数，那么基线项的配置将和指定账号基线进行合并。相同的基线项将以该参数的配置为准。建议您将该参数置空，通过`BaselineId`参数指定账号基线，通过现有基线将配置应用到账号上
parameters.name: baseline_items

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the baseline.

If this parameter is left empty, the system default baseline is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
基线ID。

置空则默认使用系统默认基线
parameters.name: baseline_id

parameters.help_en:
The identity type of the member. Valid values:

resell (default): reseller account. The created member automatically establishes a reseller relationship with your reseller, and you must use the management account to pay for the new member.
non_resell: non-reseller account. The created member is a regular Alibaba Cloud account and has no relationship with your current reseller. The account purchases resources directly from Alibaba Cloud and pays its own bills.


This parameter is supported only for reseller customers on the Alibaba Cloud International website
parameters.help_zh:
成员的身份类型。取值：

resell（默认值）：分销账号。创建的成员将自动与您的分销商建立分销关系，同时您需要使用管理账号为新成员付款。
non_resell：非分销账号。创建的成员为阿里云普通账号，与您当前的分销商无关联关系，该账号直接从阿里云购买资源，需自主付款。


该参数仅支持国际站分销客户
parameters.name: resell_account_type

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. A maximum of 20 tags can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
